title: Champion pool
subtitle: Five columns, one per position: the champions the team allows there, and who can take them.
loadFailed: Could not load the champion pool

patch.label: Patch {{version}}
patch.missingDescription: Without the patch version, a champion name and icon mean nothing three months from now: the server would rather return none. The team's selection is not lost, only unviewable until the connector answers.

floor.label: Mastery floor
floor.helper: In mastery points. Below it, a player is not offered on a champion.
floor.preview: You are looking with {{count}} points; the team saved {{team}}.
floor.explain: It belongs to the team: if it lived in each viewer's screen, two members would read two lists while believing they meant the same thing.

column.empty: No champion kept for this position
column.emptyHint: Pick from the catalogue the ones the team agrees to field here.

champion.neverPicked: No player of this position has played it

unavailable.title: No readable masteries
unavailable.description: These players hold this position, but we do not know what they master. They are set aside from nothing: we simply cannot rank them.

picker.title: Champions for {{role}}
picker.description: Click the champions the team agrees to field here. The selection belongs to the team and is there next time.
picker.catalogEmpty: The catalogue is unavailable: there is nothing to pick until the connector answers.

roster.emptyDescription: Add players in the Roster tab: coaches do not appear in this panel.

COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.title: Riot account not linked
COMPTE_RIOT_ABSENT.description: No Riot account answers to this Riot ID yet. The person links it from My profile, then claims their slots.

MAITRISES_INDISPONIBLES.title: Masteries not obtained
MAITRISES_INDISPONIBLES.description: The Riot connector did not answer for this player. Nothing to do: try again later.

CATALOGUE_INDISPONIBLE.title: Catalogue unavailable
CATALOGUE_INDISPONIBLE.description: Without the catalogue there is no name, no icon and no version — so no champion is returned, for anyone.

AUCUNE_MAITRISE.title: No mastery
AUCUNE_MAITRISE.description: Riot answered, and this account has no mastery yet. That is information, not a failure.
